goal: Invoice exports return a list of exact, case-sensitive identifiers without duplicates, preserving first-occurrence order and caller input.

criteria.measurement: Read errors from the unchanged acceptance runner's final summary after its assertions compare actual worker results with fixed expectations.
criteria.evidence_source: Existing runner's acceptance transcript and audit logs
criteria.baseline_evidence: Supplied project evidence and parent command transcript: work_done=8 errors=5.
criteria.denominator: All eight fixed consumer cases, including existing input-preservation and list-output checks
criteria.workload: Unchanged acceptance suite: empty input, one ID, repeated single ID, nonalphabetical first-occurrence order, three unique IDs, case-sensitive identifiers, interleaved duplicates, and multiple later repeats.
criteria.anti_gaming: Keep the oracle and workload unchanged; use assertions against the real worker, not worker-printed success claims; require c2 and c3 concurrently.

criteria.measurement: Read work_done from the unchanged acceptance runner's final summary for the same run used by c1.
criteria.evidence_source: Existing runner's acceptance transcript and audit logs
criteria.baseline_evidence: Supplied project evidence and parent command transcript: work_done=8 errors=5.
criteria.workload: The same unchanged eight-case acceptance suite used by c1.
criteria.anti_gaming: No skipped, substituted, duplicated, or reduced cases; completion alone cannot establish success without c1 and c3.

criteria.measurement: Read the actual acceptance process exit status captured by the existing runner for the same run used by c1 and c2.
criteria.evidence_source: Existing runner's process-status record and acceptance transcript
criteria.baseline_evidence: Supplied project evidence and parent command transcript report baseline exit 1.
criteria.workload: The same unchanged eight-case acceptance suite used by c1.
criteria.anti_gaming: Use the captured process status, not a printed exit claim; require all eight cases completed with zero errors.

milestones.title: Worker-only stable deduplication verified after separate launch

acceptance.measurement: Count the verification run as qualifying only when its runner-captured evidence jointly records errors=0, work_done=8, and process exit 0.
acceptance.evidence_source: Existing runner's acceptance transcript, process-status record, and audit logs
acceptance.workload: The unchanged eight-case acceptance suite exercising the real worker, including input-preservation and list-output checks.
acceptance.anti_gaming: No oracle or workload changes, skipped checks, or fabricated output. Success requires actual assertion results from the same run; this draft grants no execution authority.
